title: Normalize and verify canonical artifact query scope before publishing parity evidence
description: Stage 2 reusable migration platform only. Preserve all legacy routes until every family passes actual parity. Reuse existing canonical business reads/exporters, current menu/row/column/data-scope checks and audit correlation. No standalone report, arbitrary SQL/joins, schema or production operations, permission expansion or Agent work. Missing canonical/encoding/environment evidence fails closed with precise reason, never caller proof booleans. LegacyReportArtifactAdapters.ClampPageSize silently caps some canonical dynamic reads at 100 while ReportMigrationParityEvidenceService builds generic Preview parameters (1,200); artifacts contain only a selected page and do not report source total count/scope metadata. Shared comparisons must prove the same finite read scope and reject unproved truncation rather than infer full coverage from equal first-page bytes.
implementation_evidence: LegacyReportArtifactAdapters.ClampPageSize silently caps some canonical dynamic reads at 100 while ReportMigrationParityEvidenceService builds generic Preview parameters (1,200); artifacts contain only a selected page and do not report source total count/scope metadata. Shared comparisons must prove the same finite read scope and reject unproved truncation rather than infer full coverage from equal first-page bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Carry a bounded normalized finite request and canonical query result scope metadata across legacy snapshot, generic preview and actual artifacts: exact date/filter/page/page size, selected-page or all-match mode, total versus returned rows and canonical bounds. Reuse ERP-338 consistent read scope and final fresh authorization checks.

Reject silent clamp, differing scope, missing counts, incomplete all-match results, total/returned inconsistencies, over-budget or changed permission evidence; preserve original selected-page APIs and do not claim all-match completion from a prefix. Audit correlated reason without secrets or business permission expansion.

Prove nonempty guarded LocalDB cases above canonical 100-row boundaries, exact final page, filters and all-match overflow, revocation/cancellation and idempotent owned cleanup; actual artifact positive/negative byte parity and safe Release/unit plus scheduler/contracts pass. No stage gate or legacy route retirement until genuine complete acceptance.
